categories.title: What's New
items: BIP-340 Schnorr Cross-Network E2EE Relay: Genuine secp256k1 BIP-340 Schnorr cryptographic signing and verification for Nostr NIP-01/NIP-78 envelopes, enabling 100% reliable pairing and sync across 4G/5G Mobile Data CGNAT and AP-isolated Wi-Fi routers.

Fast /24 HTTP Subnet Peer Scanner: LocalSend-style parallel TCP/HTTP /24 subnet discovery sweep finds devices on the same Wi-Fi or Hotspot in under 2 seconds even when routers block all UDP broadcast and multicast traffic.
Custom E2EE Relay Settings: View active connected relay status and configure an optional self-hosted WebSocket relay directly from the Master P2P Sync hub.

categories.title: Improvements
items: Happy Eyeballs Parallel IP Racing: Simultaneously races all candidate LAN and Hotspot IP addresses with a fast 2.2-second handshake check so stale endpoints never delay pairing or sync.

Self-Healing Host Server Watchdog: Performs a 400ms loopback socket health check on app resume and diagnostics refresh, automatically re-binding port 8765 if the OS suspended the socket in the background.

categories.title: Fixes
items: Dedicated Android IPv4 Socket Binding: Explicitly binds 0.0.0.0:8765 as the primary host socket alongside an independent IPv6 listener, resolving Connection refused errors on Android kernels.
Relay Subscription Race Elimination: Added buffered NIP-78 replaceable envelopes with expiration and automatic 2.5s request retry so peers connect reliably regardless of timing.

categories.title: What's New
items: Cross-Network E2EE Blind Relay Sync: Pair, ping, and bi-directionally synchronize devices even when your Wi-Fi router has AP Client Isolation enabled or when devices are on separate Wi-Fi and Mobile Data networks.

Hotspot & Multi-Subnet Discovery: Automatic link-local multicast, gateway unicast beacons, and HTTP discovery probing let phones and tablets discover each other instantly over Personal Hotspots and Wi-Fi Direct.
Multi-Interface QR Pairing: Host QR codes now embed all active local network interfaces and automatically negotiate the fastest working path or fall back to encrypted relay transport.

categories.title: Improvements
items: Smart Mobile Data & VPN Filtering: Automatically filters out cellular Carrier-Grade NAT, 464XLAT, and VPN virtual adapters so local P2P always binds to genuine Wi-Fi or Hotspot interfaces.
Full Domain Sync Refresh: Manual and outbound P2P syncs now immediately refresh Split Bills and Savings Goals alongside Notes, Finances, and Period Tracker.
Dual-Stack Host Server Resilience: Host server automatically re-verifies and binds dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 sockets whenever opening the P2P Sync hub or displaying your QR code.
